construct_loader: construct a PyTorch data loader for train, val, or test splits using a config object
multiple_samples_collate: collate a batch with repeated augmentation samples by flattening inputs, labels, and video indices
detection_collate: collate a detection data batch by concatenating bounding boxes, labels, and metadata across samples
shuffle_dataset: shuffle a data loader by setting the epoch on its DistributedSampler for epoch-based randomization
SplitClipLoader: wrap a data loader to split video clips along the temporal dimension into smaller chunks
